tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “agency” has the meaning given the term in section 3502 of title 44.

tree.heading: Appropriate Federal entities
tree.text: The term “appropriate Federal entities” means the following:

children.text: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

tree.heading: Cybersecurity purpose
tree.text: The term “cybersecurity purpose” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Cybersecurity threat
tree.text: The term “cybersecurity threat” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Cyber threat indicator
tree.text: The term “cyber threat indicator” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Defensive measure
tree.text: The term “defensive measure” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Federal entity
tree.text: The term “Federal entity” means a department or agency of the United States or any component of such department or agency.

tree.heading: Information system
tree.text: The term “information system” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Local government
tree.text: The term “local government” means any borough, city, county, parish, town, township, village, or other political subdivision of a State.

tree.heading: Malicious cyber command and control
tree.text: The term “malicious cyber command and control” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Malicious reconnaissance
tree.text: The term “malicious reconnaissance” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Monitor
tree.text: The term “monitor” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Except as otherwise provided in this paragraph, the term “non-Federal entity” means any private entity, non-Federal government agency or department, or State, tribal, or local government (including a political subdivision, department, or component thereof).

children.heading: Inclusions
children.text: The term “non-Federal entity” includes a government agency or department of the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, the United States Virgin Islands, Guam, American Samoa, the Northern Mariana Islands, and any other territory or possession of the United States.

children.heading: Exclusion
children.text: The term “non-Federal entity” does not include a foreign power as defined in section 1801 of title 50.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Except as otherwise provided in this paragraph, the term “private entity” means any person or private group, organization, proprietorship, partnership, trust, cooperative, corporation, or other commercial or nonprofit entity, including an officer, employee, or agent thereof.

children.heading: Inclusion
children.text: The term “private entity” includes a State, tribal, or local government performing utility services, such as electric, natural gas, or water services.

children.heading: Exclusion
children.text: The term “private entity” does not include a foreign power as defined in section 1801 of title 50.

tree.heading: Security control
tree.text: The term “security control” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Security vulnerability
tree.text: The term “security vulnerability” has the meaning given the term in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Tribal
tree.text: The term “tribal” has the meaning given the term “Indian tribe” in section 5304 of title 25.
